name: llama-cpp-inline
description: Local code completion with llama.cpp: inline suggestions you accept with Tab.

llamaCppInline.automatic.description: Request suggestions while typing. Disable this to use the manual command only.

llamaCppInline.endpoint.description: llama.cpp server root URL or /v1 URL. In Remote SSH/WSL, this points to the machine running the VS Code interface.

llamaCppInline.model.description: Exact model identifier. Leave empty to use Select Model; if none is selected, detect an available coding model.

llamaCppInline.mode.description: auto tries /infill and falls back to chat only when FIM is unsupported. infill requires a model with FIM tokens.

llamaCppInline.multiline.description: Allow multiline suggestions. Defaults to one line to reduce latency.

llamaCppInline.debounceMs.description: Pause after typing before requesting a suggestion, in milliseconds.

llamaCppInline.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens generated per suggestion.

llamaCppInline.prefixChars.description: Maximum characters before the cursor sent from the active document.

llamaCppInline.suffixChars.description: Maximum characters after the cursor sent from the active document.

llamaCppInline.timeoutMs.description: Maximum wait per HTTP request, including model loading.

llamaCppInline.excludedLanguages.description: Languages without automatic or manual suggestions.
